channel.title: Flight deals from Europe | Fly4free.com
channel.description: Latest flight deals at Fly4free.com. We are bringing daily tips for cheap flights from Europe to help you save money on your next holidays.

item.title: Welcome to the paradise! 🌴 Well-rated resort on Koh Tao, Thailand 🏝️ for €65/double with breakfast in high season
item.dc:creator: Maria Shvab
item.description: If your idea of Thailand is wooden bungalows hidden among palm trees, a quiet beach, snorkeling straight into clear water and sunset dinners by the sea, this is exactly that kind of place.

item.title: 🌴 WINTER SUN COMBO! Abu Dhabi + Maldives from Prague for €599 with Qatar Airways
item.dc:creator: Maria Shvab
item.description: Why choose between a city break and a tropical island escape when you can have both? This itinerary combines Abu Dhabi’s architecture, beaches and desert landscapes with almost a week in the Maldives, all in one winter trip from Prague for €599 with Qatar Airways.

item.title: 🏝️ CARIBBEAN DEAL! Direct flights from Amsterdam to Bonaire from €394
item.dc:creator: Maria Shvab
item.description: Swap grey Dutch weather for turquoise water, coral reefs and slow Caribbean days. ✈️ TUI and Corendon are offering direct flights from Amsterdam to Bonaire from just €394 return, making this one of the easiest ways to reach a quieter side of the Dutch Caribbean.

item.title: SPRING 2027🚢 Cheap 7-day cruise aboard MSC Euribia from €499 p.p.
item.dc:creator: Maria Shvab
item.description: This is a very well-balanced 7-day / 6-night Mediterranean cruise in April aboard MSC Euribia, starting in Naples and finishing in Genoa.

item.title: Plan your perfect trip to Japan with cheap full-service flights from London to Tokyo 🗻 for £451
item.dc:creator: Giovanni
item.description: Ready to finally plan that Japan trip? Xiamen Airlines is showing discounted full-service flights from London to Tokyo Narita from just £451 return — a great fare for one of the most fascinating destinations in the world.

item.title: Cheap full-service flights from Frankfurt to Phuket, Thailand 🌴 for €472
item.dc:creator: Giovanni
item.description: Whether you're planning a relaxing beach getaway, a cultural trip, or a food lover’s adventure, Thailand is the perfect destination! China Eastern Airlines are offering affordable flights to Phuket starting at €472 for a round trip.

item.description: Looking for a great deal on flights to the Big Apple? Take advantage of this limited-time offer from Condor, one of the world’s top-rated carriers. Fly non-stop from Frankfurt (FRA) to New York (JFK) for just €382 round-trip! Comfort, convenience, and world-class service at an unbeatable price.
